analysis_unit: cell score for UMAP; donor-weighted summary; Census module share kept separate
normalization: CRC/BRCA/GSE131907 source normalized expression; LUAD CellxGene raw UMI converted to CP10k then log1p; per-gene z-score within cohort then mean across frozen members. Census: module gene counts divided by all detected counts in the 10-gene panel, donor summarized.
inference: descriptive; no cross-cohort or cross-modality test
boundary: Within-cohort z-scores are not absolute abundance or protein stoichiometry. Census shares are panel-internal, not transcriptome-wide. LUAD CellxGene NSMCE3 is zero in every cell; C2 retains frozen six-member divisor and is therefore attenuated/incomplete there.
